people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

translations.web: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.
translations.bsb: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the LORD.
translations.kjv: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.
